product.too_many_open: Close one of your open sessions before starting another.
product.transfer_offline: Lost contact. They can reconnect while this page stays open
product.transfer_waiting: Waiting for the receiver to choose where to save
product.tx_err_checksum: A file failed the integrity check and wasn’t saved.
product.tx_err_folder: A file couldn’t be copied into the folder; download it instead.
product.tx_err_protocol: The connection broke in an unexpected way.
product.tx_err_sender_files: The sender’s tab no longer has the files. Ask them to share again.
product.tx_err_storage: The browser couldn’t write the file.
product.tx_err_storage_full: This device ran out of storage space.
product.tx_err_unauthorized: The sender’s device didn’t accept this device. Ask the sender to share again.
product.tx_err_unreachable: Couldn’t reach the sender. Ask them to keep this session open, then try again.
product.tx_no_files: This tab no longer has the files you picked (the page was reloaded). Close this session and start a new one.
product.tx_other_tab: Another tab of this browser is sending these files. Keep that tab open until the transfer ends.
product.waiting_body: {name} needs to approve {device} before files are sent. Keep this tab open.
product.waiting_sender: Waiting for the sender to let you in
product.wake_refused: Couldn’t keep the screen on — keep this tab visible
product.warn_ios_keep_open: On iPhone and iPad, keep this tab open and the screen on: Safari pauses transfers in the background.
product.warn_large_ios: Files over 2 GB often don’t fit in Safari’s storage on iPhone. Use a computer if this fails.
product.warn_low_storage: This browser doesn’t have enough free storage for these files.
product.warn_mobile_background: Keep this tab in front: mobile browsers slow down or pause background tabs.
product.warn_no_storage: This browser can’t store files here, so only files up to 256 MB can be received.
product.wl_receivers_p: Anyone with the code, QR or link joins and starts receiving. Remove anyone at any time — or turn on approval.

web.home_p: Send big files to up to 5 devices — across any network. No account needed.
web.keep: Keep Share Anywhere open — don’t close it so the transfer continues.
web.keep_sub: Closing this tab stops the transfer. Your browser will ask before closing.
web.limit: Up to 20 GB per session · any file type
web.rc_p: Enter the 6-digit code shown on the sender’s screen.
web.receive_sub: Enter a 6-digit code or open a link
web.scan: Scan with Share Anywhere or a phone camera
web.send_sub: Up to 20 GB · share by QR, code or link

web_patterns.over_the_20_gb_session_limit_by_x_remove: Over the 20 GB session limit by {1}. Remove a file to continue.
web_patterns.x_devices_were_declined_automatically_se: {1} devices were declined automatically — session is full.
web_patterns.x_is_reconnecting_other_receivers_keep_g: {1} is reconnecting. Other receivers keep going at full speed.

web_vv.k1: Only needed for Clipboard Sync and syncing your device list. File sharing works without it.
web_vv.k16: Trusted devices get a key to decrypt your clipboard. Only trust devices you own. You can revoke it any time in Devices.
web_vv.k21: Both are optional. Share Anywhere works without them — you just tap a button instead.
web_vv.k23: Lets this tab read text you copy, so you don’t have to click Sync Clipboard every time. Content is encrypted before it leaves this device.
web_vv.k26: Join requests and finished transfers while this tab is in the background.
web_vv.k29: A few things to get the most out of Share Anywhere.
web_vv.k31: Big files, any device, any network.
web_vv.k32: Send 4–20 GB between Android and any browser — even across different Internet connections. No account needed to share files.
web_vv.k36: Your history stays on this device. You can sign in later for Clipboard Sync.
web_vv.k38: Direct when possible, relay when not
web_vv.k39: Pauses, resumes after drops, verifies every file with SHA-256.
web_vv.k43: Sharing works fully. Sign in to turn on Clipboard Sync.
web_vv.k54: Off by default. When on, you’re still asked before each cloud transfer, with a cost estimate.
web_vv.k59: Pause large transfers on metered connections
web_vv.k6: Unlocks Clipboard Sync between your trusted devices.
web_vv.k74: History is stored on this device only. File contents are never stored on our servers unless you approve Cloud Distribution (deleted after 24 h).
web_vv.k83: Trusted devices can receive your clipboard. Revoke anything you don’t recognise.
web_vv.k84: It loses access to your clipboard immediately.
web_vv.k85: It’s signed out of your account.
web_vv.k86: Encryption keys are rotated on your other devices.
web_vv.k87: Transfers in progress with it are stopped.
web_vv.k9: If an account exists for that email, we sent a reset link. It expires in 30 minutes.
web_vv.k90: Copy text on your Android phone, paste it here — and back. Sign in so we can link your devices and give each one a key.
web_vv.k92: Your clipboard content is encrypted before sync — we can’t read it.
web_vv.k94: Text from another device only lands in your clipboard when you click Copy.
web_vv.k96: Clipboard keys belong to your trusted devices. File sharing never needs one.

web_xx.budget_p: Cloud budget reached — paused. Raise the limit in Settings or try another route later.

web_xx.rv_1: It loses access to your clipboard immediately.
web_xx.rv_2: It’s signed out of your account.
web_xx.rv_3: Encryption keys are rotated on your other devices.
web_xx.rv_4: Transfers in progress with it are stopped.

web_xx.secw_s: Security words — receivers see the same:

web_xx.wake_set_p: Stops automatically when a transfer finishes, pauses or is cancelled.
web_xx.wake_unsup: Your browser can’t keep the screen on — keep this tab visible

web_yy.al_note: App Links open Share Anywhere directly at the incoming-files screen.
web_yy.an_q: Allow Share Anywhere to send you notifications?
web_yy.cb_empty_p: Copy text, then tap Sync Clipboard. Items from your other devices appear here.
web_yy.cbc_p: Deletes all synced items on every trusted device. This can’t be undone.
web_yy.ck_5: Open Share Anywhere on your PC: sa.link
web_yy.ck_p: A few things to get the most out of Share Anywhere.
web_yy.cp_note: Other devices stay signed in. Clipboard keys are not affected.
web_yy.cx_p: The QR, code and link no longer let anyone join. Receivers already in the session keep transferring.
web_yy.cx_rx: Code expired — ask the sender for a new code
web_yy.dv_p: Trusted devices can receive your clipboard.
web_yy.dv_sync_p: Sign in to see and trust your PC and other phones for Clipboard Sync. Sending files works without this.
web_yy.empty_p: Send a file or enter someone’s 6-digit code. Recent transfers show up here — stored on this device only.
web_yy.fp_p: We’ll email you a link to choose a new password.
web_yy.fp_sent_p: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way. It expires in 30 minutes.
web_yy.h_empty_p: Try another filter, or send something new.
web_yy.have: Already have an account? Sign in
web_yy.hc_p: Removes the list on this device. Received files stay where you saved them.
web_yy.in_p: Notifications may include alerts and sounds. Used for transfer progress and “reopen to resume”.
web_yy.in_q: “Share Anywhere” Would Like to Send You Notifications
web_yy.n_cbcleared: Clipboard history cleared on all devices
web_yy.n_welcome: Signed in · this device is trusted
web_yy.name: Name
web_yy.nf_rx: Code not found. Check the 6 digits.
web_yy.nt_off_p: You won’t see transfer progress or reminders while the app is in the background.
web_yy.off_p: You can pick files now. Sessions start and transfers resume when you reconnect.
web_yy.pr_p: The sender closed the session before RAW_shoot_day2.zip finished. Received files are saved and verified.
web_yy.pw_hint: At least 8 characters with a number
web_yy.s_appr_p: Off · anyone with a valid code joins
web_yy.s_cloud_p: Always asks first, with a cost estimate
web_yy.s_ios_bg: iOS pauses transfers when Share Anywhere leaves the screen. We’ll notify you so you can reopen and resume.
web_yy.s_priv_p: History stays on this device. File contents are never stored on servers unless you approve Cloud (deleted after 24 h).
web_yy.s_wake_p: Stops when a transfer finishes, pauses or is cancelled
web_yy.si_p: For Clipboard Sync. File sharing works without an account.
web_yy.st_auto_p: Direct P2P first, then relay. Cloud only with your approval.
web_yy.st_direct_p: Never through servers. May fail on strict networks.
web_yy.st_relay_p: More stable on mobile data and office networks.
web_yy.su_p: Unlocks Clipboard Sync between your trusted devices. File sharing never needs an account.
web_yy.tf_code: Enter the 6-digit code from the app

web_yy.tf_p_off: Ask for a code from an authenticator app when you sign in on a new device.
web_yy.ve_p: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to minh.tran@example.com.
web_yy.ve_trust: This device will be trusted for Clipboard Sync. You can revoke it in Devices.
